direct_trader_tp_gap_clarification.trader_statement: Many valid trades are entered with TP1 close, but there must still be a little gap. The trader gauges that gap from the platform TP display: $400 or more is safe; under $400 is not safe.
direct_trader_tp_gap_clarification.implementation_rule: Compare planned executable TP distance against the frozen 15-MNQ reference display. Runtime position-size reduction must not change signal semantics.
direct_trader_tp_gap_clarification.under_400_tp2_behavior: Do not blindly leapfrog untouched TP1 merely because TP2 is farther away.
direct_trader_tp_gap_clarification.processed_reaction_continuation: After the nearby TP/reaction area has actually been interacted with, a later test/attack of that same physical area with an already-approved continuation story and sustained momentum/force may earn a new entry whose destination is the next meaningful reaction.

direct_trader_rules.execution_chart: 5m is the trader entry chart; 1m is bot causal intrabar reconstruction only.
direct_trader_rules.force: The trader may enter while the 5m candle is forming after sustained directional force is real; temporary bursts and tug-of-war are not enough.
direct_trader_rules.fvg_midpoint_tp: The midpoint of an active 15m FVG is a valid TP when that FVG is the selected meaningful destination.
direct_trader_rules.fvg_edge_can_define_reaction_level: When an FVG is the meaningful structure immediately before a support/resistance area, the trader may mark the relevant end/edge of the FVG as the physical support/resistance reaction boundary.

fvg_support_resistance_interaction.rule: An FVG may act as support/resistance when price is actually treating that band as the reaction structure; FVG identity alone never creates an automatic trade.
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.resistance_behavior: For a bearish setup from an FVG acting as resistance, the candle must reject the FVG and push away with bearish force. For a bullish path through that same opposing FVG, price must disrespect/clear it with bullish control rather than treat the untouched FVG as already defeated.
fvg_support_resistance_interaction.support_mirror: Mirror the interaction for an FVG acting as support: bullish rejection plus bullish force may defend it; a bearish path through it must disrespect/clear it with bearish control.

tp_ladder.normal_rule: Use the first meaningful physical reaction as TP1 when the planned TP display is $400 or more at the frozen 15-MNQ reference size and all other A+ entry requirements pass.
tp_ladder.too_close_rule: If the planned TP1 display is under $400 at the frozen 15-MNQ reference size, the immediate entry is not safe.
tp_ladder.no_blind_rollover: An untouched under-$400 TP1 may not be automatically skipped just because a farther TP2 exists.
tp_ladder.processed_rollover_rule: A later continuation earned at the same physical TP1/reaction area through repeat-test momentum, completed-break follow-through, or weak-break pullback/15m-bar3 continuation may treat that reaction as processed and use the next meaningful destination.

direct_trader_rules.wait_semantics: WAIT is distinct from NO_TRADE and remains WAIT when the presented replay ends while the trader is still waiting.

supersedes_older_clauses: The earlier 2026-08-20 addendum clause that automatically promoted TP2 whenever TP1 fell inside Params.min_room_r * Params.stop at the actual entry clock.

Any older clause stating that a meaningful first reaction inside minimum room must always cancel every later continuation even after that same reaction has been causally processed by a valid test/attack and momentum path.
Any older clause treating every FVG solely as passive TP/confluence context when the same FVG is demonstrably acting as the support/resistance reaction structure.
Any replay validator that rejects a frozen WAIT label or silently converts WAIT to NO_TRADE.
engineering_rule: Diagnose -> repair only demonstrated fidelity defects -> permanent regression -> rerun exact-head gates. Any material executable repair invalidates prior exact-SHA promotion evidence.
